roles.title: Product Manager
roles.location: New York, New York, United States

bullets: Embed with investment and operations teams to understand workflows firsthand - requirements come from direct observation, not stakeholder translation.
Champion the user in every product decision - understand how teams actually work, what slows them down, and what they need Onyx to do differently.
Own product requirements end-to-end: discovery, scoping, engineering handoff, UAT, and go-live.
Define platform capabilities, data standards, and integration points that allow new asset types, product structures, and markets to onboard without custom builds.
Partner with engineering to evaluate system constraints, surface dependencies, and shape solutions that reduce operational risk.
